title: Process resume drops tool_search activations while replay retains loaded-tool promises
wanted_capability: Persist deferred tool activation across standalone harness process resumes and restore it only against the current filtered catalog. Older sessions should recover successful tool_search activation receipts from their durable events when no activation state exists.
fallback_used: Reload tools with tool_search after every process resume.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/registry.rs: Registry::with_options always constructs an empty activated set
session70e95922: bro_report loaded 19:44:20Z, process resumed 19:47:59Z, native placeholder queries 19:56:43Z
session2fa230ee: bro_report loaded 19:25:32Z, process resumed 19:39:33Z, subsequent native placeholder query
notes: Concrete resume contract defect; correlation with native search incidents does not prove the cause of provider query selection. Keep native search enabled.
resolution_note: Fixed in a9825318, integrated through b015e051. Deferred activations persist in existing session side-state; legacy successful paired tool_search receipts recover from durable events against the current filtered catalog. Native installed process probe passes six requests covering resume, compaction-era legacy state, denied tools and explicit empty state, with native search present throughout. Full workspace gate at b015e051 passed 6687 tests. Signed native harness installed and cage image b015e051 deployed. This resolves activation persistence only; native query-selection causality remains open in gap-900d052c.
